source: Frozen libsodium-wrappers output. See kdf.test.ts comment for the regenerable CLI command used to independently cross-check these values.
notes: libsodium's crypto_pwhash does not expose the `secret` / `ad` inputs that RFC 9106 vectors use, so RFC 9106 vectors are not directly applicable. Values below are frozen libsodium output and serve as: (a) regression detection if our wiring or parameter mapping changes, (b) algorithm-enum detection (ARGON2I13 produces different output for the same inputs), (c) a deterministic reference for QA.

lowParams.comment: Fast vector for the routine test suite. opslimit=2, memlimit=8 MiB.

productionParams.comment: Production-params vector. Slow (~1-2s). Run once to verify we have not silently changed the locked parameters.
